boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented SJNY ceremonies, observances and recurring community practices tied to the Brooklyn campus or the university community.

cards.title: Start with Investiture
cards.subtitle: First-year welcome ceremony
cards.notes: Look for the annual first-year Investiture ceremony, where new students are formally received into the SJNY community at the start of their academic journey.
cards.short_summary: A long-held formal welcome for each incoming class.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY describes Investiture as a long-held tradition that officially receives the incoming class into the university community.
cards.access_notes: The 2025 Brooklyn ceremony was held in Tuohy Hall; consult the university calendar for future dates.

cards.title: Recite the Academic Integrity Pledge
cards.subtitle: Part of Investiture
cards.notes: At Investiture, listen for the incoming class’s Academic Integrity Pledge, led in Brooklyn by the Student Government Association president in the 2025 ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A spoken pledge built into SJNY’s first-year welcome.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY reports that students take the University’s Academic Pledge during Investiture.
cards.access_notes: This occurs as part of Investiture rather than as a standalone public event.

cards.title: Mark 101 Nights
cards.subtitle: Brooklyn senior countdown
cards.notes: If it returns to the calendar, join the senior-class countdown that marks 101 nights until commencement; the university documented it as a longstanding annual celebration.
cards.short_summary: A Brooklyn graduation-season countdown with roots in the Class of 1969.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY documented 101 Nights as an annual tradition begun by the Class of 1969 and continued as part of St. Joseph’s tradition.
cards.access_notes: The cited Brooklyn event was held in Tuohy Hall Auditorium; future scheduling is not verified.

cards.title: Hear the Presidential Recital
cards.subtitle: Annual music program
cards.notes: Watch for the spring Presidential Recital in Brooklyn, where the president performs and provides musical-historical context alongside invited performers.
cards.short_summary: An annual campus recital led by SJNY’s president.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY states that the Presidential Recital has become an annual university tradition.
cards.source_title: Spring 2026 Presidential Recitals Hosted on Long Island and Brooklyn Campuses
cards.access_notes: The 2026 Brooklyn recital took place in Tuohy Hall Auditorium during Common Hour; confirm future event details.

cards.title: Follow Giving Day Projects
cards.subtitle: Universitywide annual giving event
cards.notes: During Giving Day, explore the student and organization projects presented for support; the university calls this annual fundraiser an SJNY tradition.
cards.short_summary: A recurring day of giving organized around university projects.
cards.evidence_claim: An SJNY advancement leader described Giving Day as an exciting SJNY tradition in the university’s 2024 coverage.
cards.source_title: The Direct Effect of Giving Day
cards.access_notes: The cited sixth annual Giving Day was scheduled for April 17, 2024; future dates and participation details should be confirmed.

cards.title: Attend the 9/11 Remembrance
cards.subtitle: St. Angela Hall Courtyard, Brooklyn
cards.notes: On or around September 11, pause at the Brooklyn remembrance ceremony, which has included reflection, silence, prayer and a flag-folding observance.
cards.short_summary: An annual campus observance recognizing the September 11 attacks.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY reported holding its annual 9/11 remembrance ceremony in Brooklyn in 2025.
cards.access_notes: The 2025 Brooklyn observance was in St. Angela Hall Courtyard during Common Hour; verify any future program.

cards.title: Celebrate Two Valedictorians
cards.subtitle: One for Brooklyn and one for Long Island
cards.notes: At commencement coverage, note SJNY’s two-valedictorian practice: one student represents the Brooklyn campus and one represents the Long Island campus.
cards.short_summary: Commencement honors one valedictorian from each physical campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY says it follows a tradition of selecting two valedictorians, one from each campus.
cards.source_title: SJNY Celebrates the Class of 2025 at 106th Annual Commencement Ceremony
cards.access_notes: This recognition is part of the annual commencement cycle; venue and program details vary by year.

cards.title: Spot the Green Philanthropy Cord
cards.subtitle: Commencement attire tradition
cards.notes: At commencement, look for the green philanthropy cord recognizing graduating seniors who donated to their alma mater; SJNY described it as a new tradition in 2025.
cards.short_summary: A green cord recognizing graduating seniors’ university giving.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY reported that green philanthropy cords were a new university tradition for graduating seniors who made a donation.
cards.source_title: SJNY Celebrates the Class of 2025 at 106th Annual Commencement Ceremony
cards.access_notes: The source documents the cord at the 2025 ceremony; whether it recurs in later years is not verified.

cards.title: Toast the Graduates
cards.subtitle: Annual senior recognition event
cards.notes: Follow the annual Toast to the Graduates event, where SJNY recognizes exemplary seniors with the Donald R. Boomgaarden Leadership in Action Award.
cards.short_summary: A recurring senior celebration and leadership-award presentation.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY reports that the Leadership in Action Award is presented during annual Toast to the Graduates events on each campus.
cards.source_title: SJNY Honors Exemplary Seniors with Leadership Award
cards.access_notes: The source identifies annual events on each campus; confirm the Brooklyn date, venue and attendance arrangements.

cards.title: Thank a Sister
cards.subtitle: Brooklyn Catholic Sisters Week observance
cards.notes: During Catholic Sisters Week, look for Brooklyn’s Thank-a-Sister activity and related programming that recognizes the Sisters of St. Joseph who founded SJNY.
cards.short_summary: A campus observance connecting SJNY to its founding congregation.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY hosted Brooklyn Catholic Sisters Week programming in 2026, including its Thank-a-Sister event for the Sisters of St. Joseph.
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 activities occurred in early March; this is tied to the annual Catholic Sisters Week observance.

warnings: The 101 Nights source is older than the template freshness window; it is included because it directly documents the tradition’s history, while future scheduling is not verified.
All cards use direct SJNY official pages. Event access, future dates and any admission requirements should be confirmed with SJNY.
